title: Port typed command error envelope and lossless JSON messages
scope: Complete original typed CommandError constructor/toJSON and initial code/name/message/display observations, preserving UTF-16 and exact well-formed JSON; no registry/coercion/session implementation.
acceptance: All twelve codes and fixed control/Unicode/lone-surrogate/seeded messages compare complete independent original/native field and JSON bytes, not thrown/error status.
Owned bounded fallible message storage and JSON output; native/Wasm compile and host guards.
Explicitly retain missing coercion, registry normalization, session/job/history and runtime integration scope.
open_items: 52 original observations captured before implementation; exact complete ERR1 field frames, seeds 1/7/99/1039.
Registry asCommandError, errorMessage arbitrary-value coercion, stacks/prototypes and mutable Error objects are not ported by this bounded envelope.
Actual browser runtime and public session/commands/history integration remain open.
